table.name: TLGNR_WEIGH_SYSTEM_SP_BS
table.description: Weighing systems which are used in a loadingpoint to determine the weight of a truck/load: Parallel bulk, manual LOGON, manual PDA, Container loading.

column.name: WEIGH_SYSTEM_SP_CD
column.description: PK. 0=No LDS, 1=Parallel truck bulk, 4=Container loading, 5=Parallel rail bulk, 6=WeWas bulk, 7=Fenics FBNL, 8=Dorner, 9=KDTruck, 10=D800.

column.name: PUSH_MODE_ON
column.description: Defines whether notifications are sent to this weighing system.

column.name: LDS_OFFLINE_MODE_ENABLE
column.description: Defines whether this weighing system is designed to cope with offline situations and sends regularization messages once back online.

column.name: ENABLE_TOURS
column.description: Set this to true if this weighing system supports tours.

column.name: CONFIG_TABLE_INFIX
column.description: The infix used in the config table to define the webservice parameters (wsclient.[infix].host.url etc.).

column.name: CLIENT_TYPE
column.description: The value this weighing system sends in the clientType field of the request header. Used to identify the weighing system in incoming requests.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
